name: pwtap
description: Agentic tooling for @pwtap Playwright test-automation projects

plugins.name: pwtap
plugins.description: SDLC verification & validation agents for a @pwtap Playwright suite, rendered for the plugins your project actually has

ALLOW_ACTIONS.title: Let the agent touch the device
ALLOW_ACTIONS.description: Let the mobile MCP server tap, type and swipe on the device. Off by default: mobile_perform stays listed and refuses, naming this switch.

IDLE_MS.title: Idle timeout (ms)
IDLE_MS.description: Close an unused device session after this many milliseconds. The ceiling is a blocked device lock, so the right value depends on whether you also run mobile tests on this machine.

DEVICE.title: Default device
DEVICE.description: Default device name for mobile_connect, e.g. Pixel_7_API_34. Leave blank to use whichever device is booted.
